ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

Both are first applications filed u/S 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail to the applicants/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.160/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Kanad, District Agar Malwa (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable u/S 363, 366,
120-B, 368, 376(2)(k), 376(2)(n) NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:568 2 MCRC-54969-2024 and 376(2)(j) of IPC alongwith 3/4 & 5(l)6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Prosecution story, in brief is that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was minor, aged around 17 years.

sentences.text:
Thereafter, present applicants and co-accused persons namely, Ashabai,
Radhabai and Tanisha took the prosecutrix to Kota.
Meanwhile, applicant Sonu committed rape upon the prosecutrix repeatedly.
The prosecutrix was recovered from the possession of present applicants and co- accused persons.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants/accused have not committed the offence and have falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix herself left her house and went with applicant Sonu.
After attaining the age of majority, applicant Sonu and prosecutrix solemnized the marriage and at present, she is living at the house of the applicants.
Applicants are in custody since 05.11.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial will take sufficient long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that present applicants/accused be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has objected the prayer and prayed for its rejection.
5. Counsel for the objector pleaded no objection in granting bail to the applicants.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:568 3 MCRC-54969-2024 6.

Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicants deserve to be enlarged on bail, hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the applications are allowed.

7. It is directed t h a t applicants- Rambabu, Shankar & Sonu shall be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one local surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for their appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicants shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr. P.
C/480(3) of BNSS.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of tri al but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
9. With the aforesaid, these applications are allowed and stand disposed of.
